problems.text: Applying the DNS fallback means running the firewall playbook, which also runs the ufw role on radxa and orange_pi_4a.

goals.text: The DNS fallback can be applied without touching the firewall.

outcomes.change: The DNS play lives in its own playbook and the firewall playbook is back to firewall only
outcomes.checked_by: the test reading the new playbook, `--syntax-check` on both playbooks, and a diff of `configure_network.yml` against its state before `dns-fallback`

outcomes.change: The knowledge bundle names the new playbook
